import pandas as pd
from datetime import timedelta

def format(path):
    # Read the CSV file
    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    # Check if the 4th column exists and is of datetime type
    if df.shape[1] < 4:
        raise ValueError("The CSV does not have a 4th column.")
    
    # Assuming the 4th column is named 'Time' for this example
    time_column = df.columns[3]

    # Convert the 4th column to datetime
    df[time_column] = pd.to_datetime(df[time_column], errors='coerce')

    # Subtract 3 hours from the time values
    df[time_column] = df[time_column] - timedelta(hours=3)

    # Write the adjusted data to an Excel file
    df.to_excel('/workspace/audit-export.xlsx', index=False)

# Example usage
